question: To whom are the salutations directed in this ritual formula?
premises: Salutation is offered to the teachers.
Salutation is offered with oṃ to the teachers’ sandals.
Both are part of the formula.
inference: The ritual formula offers salutations to the teachers and to the teachers’ sandals.
plain_english: Salutation to the teachers. Oṃ, salutation to the teachers’ sandals.
